About this visualisation

Based on the supplied 2009 model, which has differences from the owner's 2008 MX-5. Accessories and finishes are visual concepts, not verified fitments.

3D model: 2009 Mazda Miata MX-5 Roadster by Res1n, CC BY 4.0. Geometry optimised, parts separated, materials and plates modified by Fireball Studios.

Wheel collection: Alloy Wheel Rims (Free) by Imagigoo, CC BY 4.0. Geometry optimised, orientation and scale adjusted for this visualisation. Wheel labels follow the supplied model; physical fitment is not certified.

Drag or use arrow keys in the viewer to orbit. Scroll, pinch or use + / − to zoom. Controls below the viewer remain scrollable on mobile.
